title: Interval instrument: choose the layout
question: Choose the composition to build. Keep what feels right, or add a correction. All three retain large countdowns, persistent alarms, and labeled controls.

options.label: Wide instrument rows
options.thesis: An unmistakable alarm leads, followed by generous timer dials and their controls.

options.label: Paired dials
options.thesis: Running and paused timers sit side by side beneath the alarm.

options.label: Control station first
options.thesis: A compact alarm leads into timer creation, followed by live timers.
